date_scope: September 10 dates are recorded local timestamps and Git metadata, not independent public timestamp attestations. Public release is dated when uploaded.
code_scope: code/ is the committed snapshot at original_head, not the later dirty working tree.
trace_scope: five-color proof.drat.gz is an incomplete trace from a timeout. six-color proof.drat.gz was emitted during a SAT run. Neither is a completed UNSAT certificate.
privacy_review: All reachable original Git blobs and commit metadata, selected transcript records, and small run files scanned for credential patterns. Public-source archives inspected recursively. Retained author-local paths and original author-local Git email preserve provenance.
